svg.title: Glowing torch achievement badge
svg.desc: A clean empty original frame appears first and holds. The torch enters afterward, followed by flame ignition, then the five smaller flames and glowing embers. No stationary torch fragments or flame shadows appear before the reveal. Original frame pixels are retained; only the narrow area hidden by the source flame is filled using original frame color rows. The torch and flames continue moving, surrounded by big source-volcano celebration rays. Original image embedded inside this animated SVG.
